## Highlights

### Several model endpoints, switchable mid-session

`/model` can now choose between more than one text endpoint. Extra endpoints
live in `~/.config/coda/endpoints.json` and are managed with `/endpoint`, so the
JSON is never typed by hand:

```
/secret add grok                                        # the key, pasted, stored in the vault
/endpoint add grok https://api.x.ai/v1 grok-4 --key grok
/model                                                  # pick a model; it carries its endpoint
```

- **Keys never touch the file.** An entry references a vault entry by *name*;
  the value is read only when that endpoint is used, so no credential appears in
  `endpoints.json`, a session dump, or an error message.
- **Model and endpoint travel together.** A model is offered only for the
  endpoint that serves it, and `/model` labels each row with its endpoint.
- **The choice is per session and survives a reload.** A session naming an
  endpoint since removed from the file falls back to the default and says so.

### Pasting into the secret prompt

`/secret add` accepted no paste, so an 84-character key had to be typed blind.
It now accepts a paste, trimming a trailing newline; a multi-line paste is still
refused rather than silently mangled. The value is still never echoed, never
written to a transcript, and stored mode-600.

## Fixes

- **A model is offered only for the endpoint that serves it.** Selecting a
  vision-only model from the text column made the next message fail with
  `400 The supported API model names are …`.
- **Images on a pinned endpoint are refused rather than misrouted.** An image in
  the history used to send the request to whatever `CODA_VISION_*` names, with
  that key, while the picker showed a different provider. It is now refused
  before sending, naming both endpoints.
- **The image column draws every model.** It was drawn inside the text list's
  loop, so it could never be taller than that list; a cursor past the last text
  row was never drawn, which read as "←/→ do not work".
- **The terminal size is read at paint time.** It was cached at construction, so
  the first frame could be laid out for 80×24 in a 120×64 window.
- **Resizing repaints, and every frame erases first**, so a stale tail cannot
  survive a size change.
- **A full picker frame stays clear of the reserved bottom row.**
- **`←/→ image` is only advertised when it can act** — more than one image
  model, on the default endpoint.

## Known issues

- The `▸` cursor is drawn inside reverse video on the highlighted row, so it is
  faint.
- Vision is global, not per-endpoint: a session on another endpoint refuses
  images rather than using that endpoint's own vision model.
